name: Returning Home
summary: Returning Home marks a rite of passage for young night elf priests serving across Teldrassil. After proving themselves in the wilds, novitiates are summoned to the majestic Temple of the Moon in Darnassus to present themselves before Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

sections.title: A Summons from Darnassus
sections.body: Priests who spend their early days tending to the wounded and cleansing corruptions around Dolanaar quickly attract the attention of the Sisterhood of Elune. Trainer Laurna Morninglight intercepts promising initiates, explaining that Priestess Alathea has sent word asking for an audience. While aiding the local settlements is essential, every devotee must cultivate their communion with the Moon Mother and answer the higher calling of the faith.

sections.title: Within the Temple of the Moon
sections.body: The path leads beyond the boughs of Teldrassil into the grand heart of Darnassus: the Temple of the Moon. Rising above the city under the gentle glow of Elune's grace, the sanctuary acts as both the supreme house of worship and the spiritual capital of the kaldorei. To be invited back into these halls means one is no longer treated merely as a fledging student, but as an initiate recognized directly by the leadership of the priesthood.

sections.title: The Favor of Tyrande and Alathea
sections.body: When travelers step before Priestess Alathea, the greeting is warm and maternal. Alathea shares the leadership's watchful pride, noting that both she and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rejoice whenever initiates venture into the uncertain outside world and return unharmed. This homecoming signals the start of deeper sacred trials under Alathea's direct mentorship.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Returning Home?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight, the priest trainer stationed in Dolanaar within Teldrassil, gives the quest once a young night elf priest reaches sufficient training and experience.
Priestess Alathea resides within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, situated toward the center of the night elven capital city on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Priestess Alathea want to see me?
aliases: why go to temple of the moon
faq.answer: The elders and leadership of the Sisterhood of Elune have noted your dedicated service in the wilderness of Teldrassil. Alathea believes you are ready for advanced instruction and greater spiritual tasks.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
aliases: is returning home for all classes
faq.answer: No. Returning Home is specifically tailored for night elf priests as part of their early class development and sacred initiation into the Sisterhood's higher duties.
Upon reporting to Priestess Alathea and concluding this errand, she entrusts you with the follow-up task titled Stars of Elune.

faq.q: What is the Temple of the Moon's significance to night elves?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon is the primary center of worship for the goddess Elune and serves as the governing house where High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind guides both the Sisterhood and the kaldorei nation.

angles.text: This summons reflects a priest's transition from an ordinary forest acolyte into a formal servant of the Sisterhood of Elune answering directly to Darnassus.
For kaldorei, answering a call to the Temple of the Moon represents communion with their cultural roots and the watchful eyes of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.
